instruction: Navigate to Left 4 Dead 2 and add all downloadable content to the shopping cart.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding Left 4 Dead 2 in Steam store and adding DLC content to cart. Uses existing is_added_to_steam_cart metric to verify cart content. Similar complexity to original Dota 2 task.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL - Incomplete instruction coverage: Instruction requires adding ALL downloadable content for Left 4 Dead 2, but evaluator only checks for ONE DLC item ('Left 4 Dead 2 - The Passing')
CRITICAL - Missing expected values: Left 4 Dead 2 has multiple DLC packs (The Passing, The Sacrifice, Cold Stream, etc.) but only one is listed in expected items
Semantic mismatch: Even if agent adds only partial DLC content, evaluator would incorrectly pass as long as 'The Passing' is in cart
The metric logic itself (is_added_to_steam_cart) is correct - it checks if items exist in cart page HTML - but the expected data is incomplete
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Research all DLC content available for Left 4 Dead 2 on Steam and list ALL DLC items in expected.rules.items array
Expected items should include at minimum: 'Left 4 Dead 2 - The Passing', 'Left 4 Dead 2 - The Sacrifice', 'Left 4 Dead 2 - Cold Stream', and any other official DLC
Alternatively, if determining all DLC items is difficult, modify the instruction to specify adding a specific DLC (e.g., 'Add The Passing DLC to cart') to match the single-item expected value
Consider adding metadata field documenting the complete list of DLC items that should be verified
